purpose: Iterative log of PEARL prompt-refinement rounds. Each round runs the pilot pipeline (generate_pearl_mini.py -> OpenRouter -> analyze_pearl_mini.py) and records metrics + verdicts against the constitution proxy checks. Companion tracker: docs/research/prompt-refinement-log.md

config.state_subset: 2 burden levels (none, major) x 2 recent_steps_mean (low, high); walk_pattern=low, morning_ratio=balanced, day=weekday fixed

run.notes: 2 responses contained no valid day records; dropped from aggregation (per-cell impact not recoverable because raw results were not saved - fixed in generate_pearl_mini.py for round 2+)

C3_state_persistence.detail: high states collapse to moderate on idle

C4_action_sensitivity.detail: 1/4 cells where ability_morning raises P(high) vs idle

C5_burden_monotonicity.detail: direction ok but low states degenerate (all stay low)

C6_factor_variation.detail: morning_steps_ratio modal value is balanced in 51/52 cells

rounds.diagnosis: System prompt anchors baseline ~5,580 steps/day (moderate band) unconditionally, so 'high' (>7,000) states revert toward moderate; interventions do not shift step output enough to cross the >7,000 threshold; no instruction differentiates morning/evening step timing, so morning_steps_ratio always lands balanced (modal value in 51/52 cells).
next_steps: Make KEY FACTS state-conditional: prompt the LLM with the current recent_steps_mean band (e.g. 'your recent daily average is around 8,000 steps')
Strengthen causal framing of intervention action sentences so they raise steps relative to idle
Add morning/evening timing guidance so morning_steps_ratio varies
Save raw results in generate_pearl_mini.py (done for round 2+)
